name: Mahou Senshi EXTRA IGNITION
source:
After the victory over Serpiente, the demon lord and threat of all world, in the fierce battle, each Mahou Senshi (Magical Warrior) walked on different paths in the world where peace had been reclaimed.

However, the Goddess Guards of Roa discovered an unexpected anomaly. When Serpiente was defeated, the "Gate" which was an advanced magical device was also annihilated. However, due to that, a connection to the new unseen world was made. 

The "New World" that is different from Loa, Underworld, and Terrestrial world was discovered. In the new world, there is also a human civilization. In order to interact with the new world Creatio, Loa decided to send a delegate as an envoy of friendship. The person who was chosen as a special magic diplomat is Nanase Ririko aka Mahou Senshi Sweet Lip.

Ririko headed to Helles, the Kingdom of Creatio, with the intention to establish a friendly relationship. However, what awaited her there was a dark ploy that no one could have anticipated...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1244970]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
魔法戰士們在激戰中擊敗了威脅所有世界的魔王塞爾皮恩特。和平重歸大地，她們也各自踏上了不同的道路。

然而，羅亞的女神近衛團發現了一場意想不到的異變。魔王戰敗之際，先進的魔法裝置「門」也隨之湮滅，反而打通了前往一個未知世界的道路。

這個「新世界」與羅亞、魔界以及地上世界都不同，那裡同樣存在人類文明。為了與這個名為克雷亞蒂奧的新世界建立聯絡，羅亞決定派遣友好使節。被選為魔法特使的，是魔法戰士Sweet Lip——七瀨凜凜子。

凜凜子懷著締結友誼的願望，前往克雷亞蒂奧的雷斯王國。然而，等著她的卻是一場誰也未曾料到的黑暗陰謀……
